disorder-name.detail: Major depressive disorder; clinical cohort of 797 MDD patients diagnosed by DSM-IV or ICD-10 criteria; normative model built on HC and applied to MDD patients.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "797 individuals diagnosed with MDD... MDD diagnoses adhered to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fourth Edition (DSM-IV) or International Classification of Diseases 10 (ICD-10) criteria."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Data obtained from the REST-meta-MDD project provided by the DIRECT consortium. Site 4 and Site 25 were excluded.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "These data were obtained from a publicly accessible dataset from the REST-meta-MDD project (Yan et al., 2019) provided by the DIRECT consortium (Chen et al., 2022)."

age.detail: Age reported as mean ± SD for the MDD clinical cohort (N=797). Exclusion criteria applied: age <18 or >65 years, but exact sample min/max not reported. Mean and SD taken directly from text (35.167 ± 11.950 years).
age.supporting_text: "797 individuals diagnosed with MDD (mean age: 35.167 ± 11.950 years, 289 males and 508 females)"

sex.detail: Both male N and female N reported directly. Total N = 797. Percentages calculated: 289/797 = 36.3%, 508/797 = 63.7%.
sex.supporting_text: "797 individuals diagnosed with MDD (mean age: 35.167 ± 11.950 years, 289 males and 508 females)"
